simulation_type: deterministic hybrid kinematic and rigid-body visual simulation
validation_status: the room and operator views share a staged deterministic replay; clothing GLB index decoding, staged support heights, and per-item masses are corrected; path-clearance and released-body end-state checks remain pending
motion_model: Each trip is authored as approach, reach, grip, lift, carry, align, lower, release, and settle events. Both views follow one deterministic timeline. Items start supported on their staging surfaces and use individual illustrative masses. Grasped transport follows authored paths; release hands items to the fixed-step AABB contact solver with gravity, friction, and limited yaw rotation. The operator uses stage-driven bend poses and a damped inverted-pendulum balance controller.
assumptions: Object transport follows authored task paths.
Pickup and release are scripted grasp events.
Per-item masses are illustrative household estimates, not measured values.
The room geometry and object dimensions are illustrative rather than measured.
Suitcase dimensions are illustrative; layout checks only test the authored model bounds.
not_validated: Full musculoskeletal human balance and joint forces
asset_limitations: Full human biomechanics are not represented.
The separate assembly run's MuJoCo and Blender implementation scripts are unavailable and are not used by this packing replay.
